data.name: Milhaan
data.gender_notes: Milhaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-h-n' meaning 'grace, pleasure'. In Islamic history, the name Milhaan is associated with a righteous and generous companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Milhaan carries the meaning “Graceful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Milhaan usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies grace, pleasing to Allah and all those around you.
data.etymology: Milhaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Milhaan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
